item: shipped.csv rows become one file each (shipped.d)
key_paths: scripts/ledger_shipped.py; scripts/release_notes.py; tests/test_ledger_shipped_fragments.py; tests/test_repo_invariants.py; CLAUDE.md; docs/CONTRIBUTING.md
summary: GitHub's merge check ignores merge=union, so every PR appending a row to docs/ledger/shipped.csv made every other open PR conflict after every merge. A row is now one new file under docs/ledger/shipped.d/ (scripts/ledger_shipped.py new/check/fold); release_notes.py and the repo-invariant duplicate scan read the file first and the fragments after it. Rule (5a) amended; CLAUDE.md ceiling 782 to 785. Existing rows stay in shipped.csv; open PRs that append there keep working.
